## Motivation

fix [#9012](https://github.com/meta/docusaurus/issues/9012)

If someone uses a language that is not supported by Docusaurus by [default](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/code-blocks#supported-languages) then you have to add that language in `additionalLanguages[]` in `docusaurus.config.js`. If a language added is not in lowercase, then highlighting for that language will not work. For example  
Adding `'PHP'` or `'pHp'` instead of `'php'`
